data.desc: Processa Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company advancing differentiated therapeutic programs for immunological and inflammatory (I&I) diseases through a disciplined, science-driven development strategy. Following the acquisition of Vidya Therapeutics, Processa's lead program is VT-7208, a potentially best-in-class oral Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitor (BTKi) therapy designed to improve on efficacy and safety of earlier-generation BTKi programs. Processa is developing VT-7208 in food allergy, chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), relapsing multiple sclerosis (RMS) and exploring additional immune-mediated diseases. Processa's second program is a potentially best-in-class, preclinical oral neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) antagonist being explored for treatment of immune-mediated diseases.
